author: Mooriie
body: So, I was playing Nebula on Avicus, as normal and I was ontop of my base tower, I then decided to fall down inorder to respawn because it was going to take me ages to get down, and when I jumped down I pressed r + space bar by accident and was able to fly, Yes i confess to using this to get to the other side inorder to break the monuments, but when i got to there i decided not to do it and report it to the other players, i told them i pressed r+ space bar but the game after it still worked and i wanted to see if i could somehow get out of this fly mode, I do not know why this fly mode was activated, and believe it is a glitch because i had no clients installed and also had a fresh install of minecraft 1.8.8. I hope you understand that this was not hacking, but just a pure glitch or something like that.
